Transfer selected miQC predictions to the input object

Source: R/add_to_input_obj.R
add_to_input_obj.Rd

Transfers selected miQC classifications and associated diagnostic information from flexmix_list to the original input object. Cells without model predictions receive missing values. No cells are removed from the input object.

Usage

add_to_input_obj(
  flexmix_list,
  input_obj,
  adjustment_method,
  transfer_columns = "final",
  include_info = TRUE,
  include_model = FALSE,
  model_name = "miQCadj",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

flexmix_list

List returned by run_miQCadj() and optionally updated by adjust_classification().

input_obj

Original Seurat or SummarizedExperiment-related object.

adjustment_method

Character Scalar. Available options include "unadjusted" "original_check" or "geometry_check".

transfer_columns

Character scalar. Which columns should be added from flexmix_data to the metadata for input_obj. Available options include "all" adding all columns from flexmix_data, "method_specific" adding the method-specific columns from the corresponding adjustment_method from flexmix_data, or "final" adding only the final prediction column as selected with adjustment_method to input_obj metadata. Defaults to "final".

include_info

Logical scalar. Whether model information from flexmix_list should be added to input_obj. If a Seurat object was provided, the model information will be available in input_obj@misc. For a SummarizedExperiment object, the information will be available as metadata. Defaults to TRUE.

include_model

Logical scalar. Whether the flexmix model from flexmix_list should be added to input_obj. If a Seurat object was provided, the model information will be available in input_obj@misc. For a SummarizedExperiment object, the information will be available as metadata. Defaults to FALSE.

model_name

Character scalar. Name of model information slot. Required for adding model information to input_obj. Defaults to "miQCadj".

overwrite

Logical scalar. Whether existing destination metadata columns may be replaced. Defaults to FALSE.

verbose

Logical scalar. Whether transfer information should be printed.

Value

The input object with additional cell-level metadata. If requested, the flexmix model and / or information are added to the input object.
